research.title: Image Corruption Evaluation for Visual Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned image preprocessing routines in NumPy to apply brightness shifts and additive noise under a predefined evaluation protocol.
Ran supplied classification baselines on corrupted images, checked label alignment, and summarized confusion patterns for review by the research team.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate staff.
Maintained order logs, organized stockroom materials, and prepared routine handover notes covering pending requests and delivery status.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Classification with Linear Baselines
bullets: Implemented a scikit-learn logistic regression baseline for handwritten digit recognition using normalized pixel intensities and a predefined training split.
Compared predictions against a nearest neighbor baseline, inspected misclassified images, and documented recurring confusion between visually similar digits.
